# Agent Control

- Name: Agent Control
- URL: https://agent-control.net
- Docs: https://agent-control.net/docs
- GitHub: https://github.com/Cobra-bit-prog/agent-guard
- What: Spend control for agent wallets on Solana, Ethereum, and Base. Pre-sign check before the agent signs. Not a custodian. You hold the keys.
- Hero: Your agents can spend. You set the limits.
- Subhead: Keep control of your agents’ spending. You set the limits. Suspicious transactions show up as alerts.
- Trial: 1-day full console, no card, then Starter 29 / Pro 49 / Team 149 USDC on Solana, Ethereum, or Base.
- Contact: support@agent-control.net
